title: Run one actual JD end to end
summary: Produce resume PDF, letter PDF, JSON, portable context and an inspectable report; Lohith judges the result.
body: 2026-09-27: moved up as a baseline run (change-baseline-jd-first). Run the current app as-is on one real JD Lohith chooses; show him the resume, letter and report; record his reaction as the to-do list for checkpoint-4. The full end-to-end acceptance still depends on checkpoint-3 and checkpoint-5.
next_action: Ask Lohith for the JD, state expected cost, get a go-ahead, then run once and show the output.
